name: hl-gc-guard
description: A single shared, mutex-protected, reentrant guard around HashLink's process-global hl.Gc.enable(bool) flag, so multiple independent libraries in the same process can safely nest/overlap GC-disabled sections without re-enabling the GC out from under each other.
releasenote: Initial extraction from HaxeStackPlatform's per-library HlGcGuard duplicates (sidewinder.util.HlGcGuard, hx.injection.HlGcGuard, hxwell's HlGcGuard, PlatformUI's core.HlGcGuard) into one shared, zero-dependency class so they share a single reentrancy counter instead of four independent ones.
